scope.summary: Implement variable aliasing: a variable may reference another variable (semantic-token -> primitive-token chains), resolved through the active mode at bind time. Alias chains MUST be cycle-checked by a StudioValidationDescriptor (14.24); a cyclic alias is a validation error with a stable code.
acceptance_criteria: variable aliasing resolves through active mode; cyclic alias is a validation error
expected_tests: test: alias resolves through active mode; cyclic alias raises a blocking validation-descriptor finding

gui_obligation.not_applicable_reason: Headless/backend MT: no operator-visible surface changed.

user_manual_obligation.not_applicable_reason: Non-product-behavior or internal-scaffold MT; UserManual updated by the consuming feature MT.

risk_if_missed: No aliasing/cycle-check; semantic-token systems impossible or infinite-loop.

risks: Scaffold-only claim without runtime proof (Spec-Realism Gate).
Domain MT forking a canonical primitive instead of referencing 14.23.
SQLite creep on a studio_* write path.
minimum_controls: At least one proof command exercises executable runtime or a Handshake-managed resource boundary.
Reference canonical primitives (14.23); no shadow primitives.
